sentences.en: The hinges are really squeaky. Could you oil them please?
sentences.zh: 合叶真的吱吱作响。你能给它们上点油吗？

sentences.en: They purposely don't oil the door hinges here for security reasons.
sentences.zh: 这里出于安全原因故意不给门合叶上油。

sentences.en: He squeaks all the time like a door with rusty hinges.
sentences.zh: 他一直吱吱作响，就像生了锈的门合叶一样

senses.zh: 用铰链连接(某物), 给(某物)装上铰链

mnemonic: 发音记忆：“很紧”→铰链很紧，转不动
